qualifiers.scope: FAQ example: one-minute data requested from five months back
qualifiers.condition: Depends on the age of the data requested and the retention schedules.

evidence.quote: Depending on the age of data requested, metrics will be available at the resolutions defined in the retention schedules above.
However, if you request for one-minute data from five months back, the UI will automatically change the granularity to one-hour and the GetMetricStatistics API will not return any output.
